catalog.name: Archive SMA Cross
catalog.rule: Enter YES on a verified SMA5 > SMA10 cross; exit at the verified bid when the close falls below SMA10, else hold to settlement.

catalog.name: Archive Favourite Band
catalog.rule: Enter at the verified ask when it is 85-97c with a spread <= 5c; hold to the official result.

catalog.name: Archive Late Favourite
catalog.rule: Inside the last 20% of the archived tape, enter a favourite quoted at or above 90c; hold to settlement.

catalog.name: Archive Opening-Gap Fade
catalog.rule: When a bar opens >= 10c away from the previous bar's close, fade the gap (buy the cheap side) and exit at the verified bid 5c above entry, else hold to settlement.

catalog.name: Archive Longshot Fader
catalog.rule: When YES is 5-20c on a bar with a spread <= 5c, buy NO at 1 - yes_bid_close; hold to settlement.

catalog.name: Archive Day-over-Day Momentum
catalog.rule: Enter the direction of a >= 3c move versus the bar one day earlier; exit at the verified bid 5c above entry, else hold to settlement.

catalog.name: Archive Panic Fade
catalog.rule: On 1-minute bars, enter YES when the close is >= 15c below the prior five-minute high; exit at the verified bid 5c above entry, else hold to settlement.

catalog.name: Archive Favourite with 10c Stop
catalog.rule: Same entry as ArchiveFavourite (verified ask 85-97c with a spread <= 5c) but sell at the first verified bid 10c under the entry price; otherwise hold to settlement.

catalog.name: Archive Longshot Sweep
catalog.rule: Enter at the verified ask when it is 5-20c; hold to the official result.

strategy.name: 75-80c Entry / 95c Take-Profit
strategy.rule: Buy a side quoted 75-80c (displayed spread <= 5c) with >= 2 minutes left; sell when the bid reaches 95c, else hold to settlement.

source.label: r/KalshiBTCUporDown15 'limit buy at 75-80c, take-profit at 95c' post (recreated mechanically; the sibling KalshiPaperSim measured it at -65.03% on its history)
